description: Source code implementing IPC service functions for device communication in Zephyr RTOS, including functions for opening, closing, registering endpoints, sending data, and managing buffers.

methods.name: ipc_service_open_instance
methods.description: Opens an IPC service instance for a device.

methods.name: ipc_service_close_instance
methods.description: Closes an IPC service instance for a device.

methods.name: ipc_service_register_endpoint
methods.description: Registers an IPC endpoint with a device.

methods.name: ipc_service_send
methods.description: Sends data through an IPC endpoint.

methods.name: ipc_service_get_tx_buffer_size
methods.description: Retrieves the transmit buffer size for an endpoint.

methods.name: ipc_service_get_tx_buffer
methods.description: Gets a transmit buffer for an endpoint.

methods.name: ipc_service_drop_tx_buffer
methods.description: Drops a transmit buffer for an endpoint.

methods.name: ipc_service_send_nocopy
methods.description: Sends data without copying through an IPC endpoint.

methods.name: ipc_service_hold_rx_buffer
methods.description: Holds a receive buffer for an endpoint.
